title: A Solution Concept for Convex Vector Optimization Problems based on a User-defined Region of Interest
summary: This work addresses arbitrary convex vector optimization problems, which constitute a general framework for multi-criteria decision-making in diverse real-world applications. Due to their complexity, such problems are typically tackled using polyhedral approximation. Existing solution concepts rely on additional assumptions, such as boundedness, polyhedrality of the ordering cone, or existence of interior points in the ordering cone, and typically focus on absolute error measures.
